description: Create a task and return the created task. list_id defaults to the org's first list when omitted; feature_id / insight_id link it to the spine and sprint_id schedules it into a sprint. Resolve list/status/feature/insight/member ids via pm_meta and sprint_id via list_sprints — never guess them. Only title is required.

assignee_member_ids.description: Member ids to assign, from pm_meta (optional).

feature_id.description: Feature id to link on the spine, from pm_meta or list_features (optional).

insight_id.description: Insight id to link on the spine, from list_insights (optional).

list_id.description: List to create the task on; resolve the id via pm_meta (optional; the org's first list when omitted).

sprint_id.description: Schedule into a sprint (optional; resolve the id via list_sprints).

status_id.description: Initial status; resolve the id via pm_meta (optional).

name: create_task
title: Create Task
